hard_rules: wow-cbm depends directly only on wow-core
provider descriptors are reviewed immutable inputs and runtime negotiation cannot widen them
process session credential provider lifecycle and provider index effects remain outside E6-A
no generic arbitrary MCP or tool call surface
every normalized result remains semantic_candidate plus Candidate
provider exact verified authoritative top sole repeated and high-score labels never upgrade authority
scores and ranks remain provider-local and are never compared numerically across providers
provider locators remain UnverifiedProviderLocator and never become project or reference source handles inside E6-A
zero results never create negative authority
continuation and cache bind exact descriptor capability state query profile and cumulative budgets
opaque external state is explicitly nonreproducible
provider failure is lane-local and never degrades exact local workflows
no hidden provider stale-cache model web local-search or broadened-query fallback
source snippets labels summaries paths and errors remain untrusted data
no provider database index source filesystem URL process editor client model or credential access
E6-B owns exact owner mapping explicit candidate selection context handoff durable effects retention and CLI
missing implementation transport probe benchmark fixture or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass
no Cargo Rust source or CI during documentation phase

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: wow-core implementation commit and fixture digest
reviewed provider descriptor and adapter contract IDs
transport and capability negotiation probe reports
external-state query normalization score loss locator zero-result continuation cache privacy license security and canonicalization profiles
synthetic compatible malformed hostile partial zero opaque mutable stale continuation and cancellation provider fixtures
accepted measured byte item depth time memory and candidate limits
all canonical result explanation artifact comparison cache and error vectors
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
